understanding.goal_understanding: Win each level by getting every goal tile ('+' in the semantic grid) occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; when the engine reports WIN for the level-run, the whole game is completed.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (MOVE_LEFT/RIGHT/UP/DOWN) shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) unless blocked by walls/boundaries or other objects; adjacent pushable blocks can be pushed if there is space. Levels can contain multiple selectable pieces, and control is switched with CLICK by providing the exact pixel/grid coordinates of the target selectable (matching the coordinates shown in player.position/objects lists). The movement.*_blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and don’t guarantee movement will fail.
